description.zh: 文件的ID，您可以通过[ListFiles](~~173942~~)查询对应文件的ID。该参数与NodeId参数配置一个即可。
description.en: The file ID. You can call the [ListFiles](~~173942~~) operation to obtain the ID. You need to configure either this parameter or the NodeId parameter.

description.zh:
待发布文件在调度系统对应的任务ID。
该参数与FileId参数配置一个即可。
description.en: The task ID of the file to be deployed in the scheduling system. You need to configure either this parameter or the FileId parameter.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。
您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the ID. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间名称。
您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace page to query the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to identify the DataWorks workspace when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public deploy-file --project-id 10000 --project-identifier dw_project --file-id 10000001 --comment First_release_task --node-id 2000001 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public DeployFile --region cn-hangzhou --ProjectIdentifier dw_project --Comment First_release_task --ProjectId 10000 --NodeId 2000001 --FileId 10000001
